summary: Retry only explicitly safe FedEx reads and return typed outcome-unknown errors for ambiguous mutation failures.
reason: The shared FedEx client retried every method after transport errors, rate limits, and server errors, which could duplicate shipments, labels, pickup requests, cancellations, and other remote mutations.
validated_outcome: Mock-server and transport tests confirm mutation requests execute once, 429 responses are not retried, ambiguous transport and 5xx failures return OutcomeUnknownError, and allowlisted read-only POST operations retain bounded retry behavior.
